nonBlockingNotes: record-service.ts is now 1655 lines (+325 from wave 2). Growth is spec-directed (spec explicitly targets this file for both new verifier branches) and architecturally consistent with the existing command-verifier pattern. Not a god-file violation, but worth watching if more verifier kinds land in the same module.

The test named 'subagent dispatch honors requireFreshEvidence with stale evidence' tests the dispatch-timestamp freshness cutoff, not the criterion.requireFreshEvidence flag (which is checked separately at the completion gate in service.ts). The test name is slightly misleading but the behavior is correct per spec: 'requireFreshEvidence honored: read newest evidence record written AFTER dispatch timestamp'.

partial outcome from subagent evidence is correctly mapped to 'fail' via outcomeFromEvidenceFile but is not covered by an explicit test. The spec's named-test list does not require it, so this is consistent.

Empty-agent edge case: if 'Agent:' is present but blank in charter.md, TypeBox accepts empty string and verifySubagentCriterion would pass agent='' to the systemPrompt. Planner responsibility to supply a valid name; schema does not enforce non-empty.
summary: Both features implement their dispatcher branches correctly. All 10 spec-named tests pass (5 for f4, 5 for f5). Type check is clean. Evidence-exists reuses loadFeatureEvidence as required, handles both dir-per-run and legacy flat layouts, freshSince filtering, and kind mismatch. Subagent dispatch correctly sets dispatchStartedAt before spawn, sorts candidates by evidenceTimeMs descending, maps partial→fail, records typed evidence into criterion-state, and interpolates the full template including commands.<key>.
because: Diff inspected against f4 and f5 specs line by line. Test output shows 10/10 pass with no truncation. TypeScript compiler emits no errors. Logic walkthrough confirms: (1) evidenceKindFromRecord handles root-level and nested kind fields; (2) newestTypedEvidenceAfterDispatch uses Math.max(evidenceTimeMs, fileStat.mtimeMs) >= dispatchStartedAt for freshness; (3) verifier schema guards in charter-md.ts/verifier.ts reject malformed subagent/evidence-exists specs at parse time; (4) both branches call recordEvidence (not recordEvidenceLocked) so no nested-lock issues; (5) all five spec-named tests per feature are present with correct assertions.
